original.statement: Upgrading to external-secrets 0.16.0 requires a pre-upgrade step ensuring v1alpha1 is no longer listed in status.storedVersions of the externalsecrets, clusterexternalsecrets, secretstores and clustersecretstores CRDs (removing it if the guide's kubectl check reports NOT SAFE and persisting that status), because 0.16.0 removes the v1alpha1 version from these CRDs while adding v1.

decision.reason: [ev-07d67e9be26a] is a pre-upgrade check in the 0.16 upgrade guide. It tells operators to run a kubectl check and, if it reports NOT SAFE, to remove v1alpha1 from the stored versions of the four CRDs and make sure that status is persisted. That is a mandatory operator step, so the migration family with the change type migration-required fits. The name remove-v1alpha1-stored-versions is built from the guide's own words. The rendered diffs [ev-4a1f27e04efd][ev-f978a29a8906][ev-04b0055709ca] support the reason for the step: v1alpha1 is removed from spec.versions of the externalsecrets, clustersecretstores and secretstores CRDs in the 0.16.0 chart.
